Frequently Asked Questions

We offer credit card billing.

You will be billed when you go live with HROne. There is zero contractual lock-in, so you have the flexibility to stay with us as long as you like or discontinue the services as per your business requirement.

No, there’s no additional cost apart from the base pricing and charges for the add-ons you choose. However, please note that an implementation cost may apply for enterprise-level clients.

HROne offers comprehensive support, including certification during the implementation process, resolving regular tickets, unlimited product training, separate training for new feature adoption, and special enhancement features (with implementation cost).

The pricing model we follow is feature and user based.

Yes, we do. Our three standard plans are based on features. You can check them above. The basic plan is 85/user/month, professional is 115/user/ month and enterprise plan are customisable and quote is shared on request. The mobile app comes as a gift from us to you.

It is only and only based on features, no hidden pricing. The plan you pick is then charged per user basis.

No, there is no fixed lock in period. HROne gives its clients the flexibility to pause or stop the subscription. However, prior notice before 2 months is required to ensure smoother exit and transition.

Yes. It is included in the pricing. The support team is known for its high SLAs and best closure rates. Once implementation is done, a support expert is designated to you. You can reach out to them if you get stuck anywhere and they shall respond in less than 24 hours.

HROne offers a flexible, modular pricing system for businesses. But you can always upgrade your plans depending on company's your size, modules, and customization needs.

There is no average cost for HRMS implementation for 300 employees as costs can vary based on modules, customization, and vendor support. What's more important is to know how much value for money your are getting as ROI after switching to an HRMS.

If you have to, compare ease of use, compliance coverage, automation, and pricing. A company with a headcount of 100 employees needs an HRMS like HROne that offers a wide range of features, individual modules, flexible plans, and AI-powered employee agent.

The Enterprise plan by HROne is the perfect plan for a company with a workforce of 300 strength. It offers all its 10 modules, including recruitment, performance engagement, expense, asset, and helpdesk, helping you save your expenses from buying different HR platforms for different HR operations. I

HROne's modules are designed to plug in seamlessly without disrupting existing workflows. You only have to contact your account manager for an anytime upgrade.
